paraphrase: Lumen gentium teaches that Jesus Christ built the Church by sending the apostles as he himself was sent by the Father; that he constituted the twelve as a college or stable body and sent them, as sharers of his power, to make all peoples his disciples and to sanctify and govern them, so propagating the Church; and that the universal Church gathered by their preaching is the Church which the Lord founded in the apostles and built upon Peter. A conciliar doctrinal assertion: neither the historicity of the sending nor a grant of authority follows from its being asserted.
